use_case: AI eligibility assistant (SYS-11, IES): extracts data from verification documents for SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid applications and suggests SNAP and TANF eligibility outcomes to AG-03 caseworkers
business_owner: Chief Data and AI Officer (company); AG-03 program director for the pilot region (deployer)
vendor_or_model: Company-built feature on the managed large language model service in the IES account (Cloud provider B)
data_categories: Applicant and household data; income and expense documents; Social Security numbers (Restricted); no FTI permitted
human_in_the_loop: AG-03 caseworkers (state merit staff) make every decision. Suggestions are off from 2026-09-11; they return only with review-first design, deterministic calculations, and weekly supervisor review of 10% of AI-assisted denials
applicable_laws: 7 CFR 272.4(a)(2) and 42 CFR 431.10 (merit staff and the Medicaid agency decide); 7 CFR 273.10(g)(1)(ii), 273.15(a), 42 CFR 431.200(a) (notices and fair hearings); 7 CFR 273.2(g)(1), (i)(3)(i) (deadlines); 7 CFR 272.6(a) (nondiscrimination); 7 CFR 272.4(b) (bilingual service); N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306(b)) and 7 CFR 272.1(c) (confidentiality); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.11.2, no FTI); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Pilot (120 caseworkers, 1 region); approved with conditions 2026-09-10; suggestions off from 2026-09-11
company_role: Developer and operator; AG-03 is the deployer
committee_review: Intake approval for the pilot 2026-02-18 (no risk assessment); full assessment 2026-08-19
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as model inputs; document language and household age affect accuracy
bias_testing_status: Validation sample of 600 cases (English-only test data before the pilot); 1,500-case stratified test due 2026-12-31
monitoring: Monthly 100-case QC sample; acceptance, override, and adverse-error rates; quarterly bias test

use_case: Document classification and data extraction for scanned verification documents at the IES document processing centers
vendor_or_model: Document capture software vendor (machine learning classification and OCR)
data_categories: Scanned applicant documents; Social Security numbers (Restricted); AG-04 ePHI
human_in_the_loop: Document processing staff verify low-confidence fields; second-person check of 5% of indexed pages each day
applicable_laws: N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306); 7 CFR 272.1(c); N92-R03 (45 CFR 164.314(a), AG-04 business associate scope); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
company_role: Operator (vendor model configured by the company)
bias_testing_status: Accuracy by document language tracked monthly; no gap above 3 points in 2026
monitoring: Daily QC sample; monthly field accuracy by document type and language

use_case: Case note summarization for agency users in ACMC (generative), offered to local government tenants only
vendor_or_model: Managed large language model service in the ACMC account (Cloud provider A)
data_categories: Local government case notes (constituent services, permits, code enforcement); disabled for CJI, FTI, and motor vehicle tenants
human_in_the_loop: Agency staff read the source notes; summaries labeled AI-generated and never filed as the record
applicable_laws: Agency contracts; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) for Florida tenants; POL-04 4.8
company_role: Developer and operator; each tenant opts in
bias_testing_status: Not applicable (no decisions about individuals); accuracy sampling

use_case: Contact center virtual agent answering applicant questions on application status, office hours, and required documents (IES)
vendor_or_model: Contact center platform vendor conversational AI
human_in_the_loop: Hands off to a person on request, after two failed answers, or on any eligibility question; AI disclosure at the start of each call and chat
applicable_laws: N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306); 7 CFR 272.1(c); 7 CFR 272.4(b) (bilingual service); agency contracts
status: In production (AG-03 and one other state)
company_role: Operator (vendor model configured by the company)
bias_testing_status: Answer accuracy tested in English and Spanish; Haitian Creole not offered (routes to staff)
monitoring: Monthly transcript sample; containment and escalation rates by language

use_case: Contact center call transcription and quality analytics (speech-to-text, topic and sentiment tagging) for agent coaching
vendor_or_model: Telephony platform vendor feature, enabled in a 2026-05 release
data_categories: Call recordings and transcripts with applicant data (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None today; becomes Employment if used to rate staff performance
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors review flagged calls; not used for discipline (to be confirmed by the review)
applicable_laws: Recording consent under each state's law (all-party consent announced on every call; Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example); N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306); agency contracts
committee_review: Not reviewed (found in the 2026-07 inventory sweep; review due 2026-12-31)
protected_characteristic_inputs: Language and accent may affect transcription

use_case: Pretrial risk instrument scoring configured in ACMC for AG-02 pretrial services (points-based actuarial instrument chosen and validated by the agency)
business_owner: Vice President, ACMC Platform Operations (configuration); AG-02 pretrial services director (owner of the instrument)
vendor_or_model: Agency-selected public instrument, configured as rules in ACMC
consequential_decision_category: Legal (liberty: release recommendations to the court)
human_in_the_loop: Pretrial officers review every score and may override with a reason; judges decide release
applicable_laws: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1); AG-02 contract; the agency's state law on pretrial release (agency duty)
company_role: Host and configurer; AG-02 owns and validates the instrument
protected_characteristic_inputs: Age and criminal history items (the instrument's defined factors)
bias_testing_status: Agency validation study (2024); the company tests that ACMC scores match the published scoring rules on every release
monitoring: Scoring regression test each release; quarterly override rate report to AG-02
